blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Minimum wage earners in Western Visayas will start receiving an additional P40 to P45 in their daily pay beginning on Friday, Nov. 20, following the implementation of a new wage order. The increase stems from Wage Order No. VI-30, which the National Wages and Productivity Commission approved after consultations with workers and employers, according to the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE). Under the new rates, workers in non-agricultural, industrial, and commercial establishments employing more than 10 workers will receive a P40 increase, bringing their daily minimum wage from P550 to P590.
